prompt: P(A)=0.2, P(+ | A)=0.9, P(+ | not A)=0.1. Given a positive result, find P(A | +). Give a decimal.
A bag has 5 red and 3 blue beads. Draw 2 without replacement. Given at least one is red, find P(both red).
solution: There are C(8,2)−C(3,2)=28−3=25 pairs with a red. C(5,2)=10 are both red; 10/25=0.4.
